P0-1.rootCause: setInput used isOpposite(direction, snake.direction). After a full left circle angleToDirection returns starting cardinal (right) while player intent is left — falsely treated as 180° reversal.
P0-1.fix: Removed discrete opposite block from setInput; smooth maxTurn in advanceSnakePath limits reversal speed. normalizeAngle on snake.angle prevents drift.
P0-1.test: games/snake/src/__tests__/snake-phase2-1.test.ts — left accepted at angle=0 heading right

P0-2.rootCause: Character-less bots missing headCharacter/pendingDirection/desiredAngle/awaitingInput clear — tickWorld skipped movement when awaitingInput=true or direction undefined.
P0-2.fix: ensureBotReady + ensureSnakeMovementReady on spawn/tick/respawn/sync; repairWorldBots in syncSnakePopulation; desiredAngle synced in runBotBrain.

P1.after: PC: SPACEBAR : BOOST (or ⚡ BOOST when active) only; Mobile: BOOST only
